evals.prompt: We have FDA 510(k) clearance for our ECG arrhythmia-detection software (class II, product code DQK) and want to go to the EU, the UK, Switzerland and Australia next. Map what each region requires, which of them will accept our FDA clearance, and what we must register afterwards.

Our pivotal study of a diabetic retinopathy screening algorithm ran in 2025 at 6 sites in Germany and Spain, ethics-approved, 1,400 patients, no breakdown by ethnicity. Can we reuse it for the FDA, Health Canada and the TGA, and can we keep one technical file for all of them plus the EU?

Three options for our class IIb-in-the-EU sepsis prediction software: (A) EU MDR first then Switzerland, UK and Australia; (B) FDA De Novo first then Australia, Canada and Brazil; (C) MDSAP audit first then Canada, US and Australia. Criteria and weights: reliance reach 0.4, evidence reuse 0.2, readiness 0.2, route certainty 0.2. My scores: A 3,3,2,4; B 4,2,2,3; C 3,2,1,3. Which order, and what do we adapt per region? Regulatory lead is Dana Koch for EU and CH; nobody named for the rest yet.

Write the cover letter to the MHRA saying our software is approved under the UK international reliance scheme because we have FDA clearance, and state that it is class I in Great Britain so no approved body is needed.
